author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Olivia (OC Illustration)
title: Michigan artists - looking for live illustrators to join team
content: 🎨 Michigan artists! OC Illustration is looking for live illustrators to join our team! Hi everyone! My name is Olivia, and I own OC Illustration, a live illustration studio based in Michigan. We provide elegant, minimalist fashion-style illustrations at weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across the Midwest! We’re growing our team and looking for talented, enthusiastic artists to join our small roster of contract illustrators in Michigan. Paid, part-time, contract work. Approximately 2–3 events per month. Interested? Comment or fill out the application below! Check out our work: https://www.ocillustration.com/workwithus
